gate_decision.rationale: The residual carries simulator-known measurement information and still leaks crystal-system information, supporting a V10 disentanglement pilot.

inputs.derived_profile_note: ood_texture is reset to level0 for all non-texture operators; other OOD family profiles already isolate their target operator

interpretation_limits: Passing supports a V10 pilot; it does not prove disentanglement or final performance benefit.
Failure at a five-epoch backbone state does not permanently falsify V10 and should be rechecked after formal V9 training if Residual remains scientifically relevant.
The gate must not be used to change V9 lambdas, the backbone, the frozen OOD profiles, or the formal V9 comparison.

protocol.backbone_state: five-epoch Dynamic/Paired ERM rebuilt in memory
protocol.family_probe_residuals: both absolute normalized V9 residual and signed normalized V10 residual; the Gate decision uses the signed residual
protocol.pair_definition: level0 anchor versus one controlled OOD perturbation family
protocol.strength_probe_residual: signed normalized residual, matching the V10 perturbation-delta direction

purpose: Train-only non-performance gate for simulator-known measurement information in the current residual representation
